verdict.rationale: Sai's own docs say the same agent runs on macOS and Windows devices via BYOD, plus cloud Windows computers, and the open-source framework is described as working "across environments." Per-target support is only a single marketing-level line, though, with no per-OS documentation of capabilities, limitations or setup. Missing for 10: per-OS documentation of supported features and limitations, Linux or mobile targets, and independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-OS behavior.
